use: Later IVIVE analysis-module review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.
approval_boundary: Approval covers conditional data requirements only. Original method-selection, extrapolation and prediction-evaluation content is retained for separate review and is not enabled for execution.

sources.title: Ring et al. (2011): PhRMA CPCDC initiative, part 3: prediction methods of human clearance
sources.supports: Allometry and IVIVE require different inputs and binding conventions. IV CL comparison involved 19 drugs; applicability to a new drug remains to be assessed.

reference_profile.name: In vitro hepatic clearance extrapolation
reference_profile.applies_when: The project permits IVIVE and the drug's disposition supports considering a hepatic metabolic method.
required_inputs: Relevant microsomal/hepatocyte intrinsic-clearance or stability evidence with units
Experimental system, normalization and assay conditions
A specified scaling model and its physiological/scaling inputs
conditional_inputs: Incubation and plasma/blood binding where required by the selected method
Evidence on uptake limitation, other organs or other elimination pathways when material
acceptable_alternatives: Retain animal-based prediction as a separate candidate when its own prerequisites hold
preflight_checks: Check assay applicability and quantify what elimination component is represented
Keep human in vitro input permission distinct from human PK holdout permission
post_analysis_checks: Assess method bias, assumptions and uncertainty for the intended chemical/mechanistic domain
reference_profile.missing_effect: An unavailable hepatic-IVIVE input blocks that candidate, not unrelated animal parameter estimation.
not_established: Total systemic clearance solely from a hepatic component
Universal superiority of one binding convention
